name: Phase 5E Graph and Network Intelligence Invariants

invariants.name: Directed Message Passing Invariant
invariants.verification: Proved via oracle unit test: target node aggregates source node, source node receives zero incoming aggregate when in-degree=0.

invariants.name: Multi-Edge Structural Preservation Invariant
invariants.formula: |E(u, v)| \ge 1 \implies \forall e_i \in E(u, v), \mathrm{type}(e_i) \text{ and } \mathrm{attrs}(e_i) \text{ preserved}
invariants.verification: MultiDiGraph ensures parallel relationships (e.g. 50% ownership + directorship) exist concurrently without overwriting.

invariants.name: Elementary Cycle Determinism Invariant
invariants.formula: C = (v_1, \dots, v_L) \text{ s.t. } v_1 = \min_{i} v_i, \quad \mathrm{RingID} = \mathrm{SHA256}(v_1 : \dots : v_L)[:16]
invariants.verification: Canonical rotation deduplication guarantees a unique, deterministic 16-character SHA-256 identifier for each directed cycle.

invariants.name: Local Adjacency Encapsulation Invariant
invariants.verification: Subgraph cluster detection constructs private local adjacency dictionary, preventing global adjacency clobbering.

invariants.name: Metamorphic Edge Ordering Invariance
invariants.verification: Tested and passed with atol=1e-5 on arbitrary edge permutations.

invariants.name: Disconnected Component Independence
invariants.verification: Mutating edges in component B produces bit-for-bit identical embeddings in disconnected component A.

invariants.name: L2 Unit Sphere Normalization Invariant
invariants.verification: Ensured by F.normalize(..., p=2, dim=1) across all GraphSAGELayers and post-inference DP projection.

invariants.name: Finite Numerical Representation Invariant
invariants.verification: Validated via np.all(np.isfinite(...)) and np.nan_to_num in feature extraction and embedding service.
